ranked.headline: Learned models integrate and annotate single-cell and spatial omics across platforms
ranked.summary: Learned single-cell and spatial methods now integrate across platforms and gene panels, and are being tested by systematic benchmarks.

ranked.headline: Graph and alignment-free methods resolve variants and haplotypes from reads
ranked.summary: Long-read, short-read, and single-cell datasets are driving scalable methods that make fewer assumptions about haplotype number and divergence.

ranked.headline: Batch harmonization, deconvolution, and imputation in sequencing-based transcriptomics
ranked.summary: Growing cfDNA, spatial, and multicondition datasets demand correction models that separate technical variation from biological signal.

ranked.headline: Deep models recover regulatory structure from sparse single-cell and multiomic data
ranked.summary: Foundation-scale pretraining and interpretable, multimodal interfaces are now applied across scRNA-seq, multiomic, and spatial regulatory tasks.

ranked.headline: Deep architectures link heterogeneous molecular and imaging inputs to clinical targets
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair graph, VAE, and contrastive models with multi-omics and imaging data for prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Compositional and error-model choices shape omics differential expression and prediction
ranked.summary: Transformation and error-model choices now determine false discovery control and biomarker accuracy across microbiome, RNA-seq and proteomics data.

ranked.headline: Models rank and interpret small molecules before experimental testing
ranked.summary: Experimental validation and blind comparisons now test computational compound prioritization directly against measured outcomes.

ranked.headline: Computational frameworks extract mechanistic and spatial structure from single-cell omics
ranked.summary: Spatial and time-resolved single-cell datasets now demand interpretable models that link tissue context, dynamics, and regulation.

ranked.headline: Genomics algorithms re-implemented for parallel, GPU, and out-of-core execution
ranked.summary: Large genomic interval datasets and sequencing workloads are being addressed with parallel, out-of-core, and HPC-scalable tool implementations.

ranked.headline: New methods refine genetic association and variant prioritization in GWAS
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend GWAS, rare-variant and fine-mapping models with functional annotations, missingness and regulatory deep learning.

ranked.headline: ML links omics and drug data to biomarkers, targets, and perturbation responses
ranked.summary: Web-delivered ML tools now bundle multi-omics integration, LLM agents, and feature selection for biomarker and target nomination.

ranked.headline: Automated workflows and reference resources standardize microbial genomic analysis
ranked.summary: Recent tools and databases automate taxonomic classification, prophage profiling, amplicon analysis, and ancient-metagenome authentication workflows.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models for TCR, MHC, and antibody recognition of antigens
ranked.summary: Recent work benchmarks TCR-pMHC structure models on unseen complexes and extends receptor-recognition modeling to B cell epitopes and antibody maturation.

ranked.headline: Stability, criticality, and excitability constrain neural dynamics across multiple scales
ranked.summary: Unified and theory-neutral frameworks now link single-neuron, circuit, and whole-brain constraints on neural dynamics.

ranked.headline: Single-cell spatial and imaging data constraining mechanistic tumor and tissue models
ranked.summary: Spatial transcriptomics, live imaging, and physics-based simulation are now being coupled to infer and model cell states rather than correlation alone.

ranked.headline: Scrutiny of genomic deep-learning models targets confounders, missingness, and leakage
ranked.summary: Genomic deep-learning predictors are being audited for explanation failures, missing-value robustness, and split-design leakage before their outputs are…

ranked.headline: Reference-anchored benchmarks reveal variability in variant calling across pipelines
ranked.summary: Reproducible, truth-anchored evaluation across variant classes and sequencing platforms is now being applied to short-read, long-read, and array data.

ranked.headline: Structure-conditioned flow-matching models now drive protein design and docking
ranked.summary: Predicted structures and synthetic structure-sequence pairs are now reused as training substrates for generative protein design and docking.

ranked.headline: Multi-omics and curated databases refine gene target and regulatory annotation
ranked.summary: Integrating expression, genetic, and LLM-assisted curation now yields more complete gene-level annotations across mouse, human, and disease contexts.

ranked.headline: Identifiability and coupling limits define when microbial community models remain valid
ranked.summary: Published workflows and coupling-threshold analyses now test whether microbial community models yield trustworthy parameters and dynamics.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and algorithms for DNA hashing, pooling, and biosynthetic gene similarity
ranked.summary: Standardized parameters, benchmarks, and collision-free methods are making large sequence and chemical libraries more comparable and usable.

ranked.headline: Complete genome assemblies expose Y-linked duplications and structural variants
ranked.summary: Improved contiguity from HiFi, nanopore and Hi-C data now resolves sex-linked and repetitive regions in insect and fly genomes.

ranked.headline: Bayesian inference for stochastic biochemical and epidemic models at scale
ranked.summary: Inference cost, not model formulation, now limits Bayesian calibration of mechanistic stochastic models in biology and epidemiology.

ranked.headline: Computational frameworks extract more reliable brain biomarkers from neuroimaging data
ranked.summary: Recent 2025 preprints and publications propose computational frameworks aimed at more robust, interpretable neuroimaging biomarkers.

ranked.headline: Learned models decode Pol II dynamics, chromatin compartments and condensate formation
ranked.summary: Predictive models now infer Pol II kinetics, nascent transcription patterns, chromatin subcompartments and condensation propensity from molecular and…

ranked.headline: Compact indexes and k-mer search speed up sequence classification and comparison
ranked.summary: Recent tools compress taxonomic indexes and embed plasmid ORFs to make sequence comparison tractable at scale.

ranked.headline: Generative models and experiments map sparsely populated protein conformational states
ranked.summary: Diffusion sampling, NMR-guided ensemble selection, and cryo-EM population inference now target excited and minor conformational states.

ranked.headline: Atom-level geometry guides computational design of enzyme active sites
ranked.summary: Deep generative and hybrid ML-atomistic methods now scaffold benchmark active sites, while geometric descriptors target substrate prediction.

ranked.headline: Learned representations drive biomedical prediction across clinical and molecular tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a December 2025 publication extend learned models to clinical outcome, relation and interaction prediction.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models decode sleep, EEG artifacts, musical attention and light exposure
ranked.summary: Deep models are being evaluated on wearable and consumer-grade recordings, with explicit tests of generalization across devices, subjects, and songs.

ranked.headline: Open simulation tools for RNA reactors, historical range evolution and ODE models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a curated repository release simulators for RNA reactor kinetics, range evolution, and ODE model verification.

ranked.headline: MD simulations resolve ligand, peptide and glycan effects on receptor conformation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply all-atom and steered MD to peptide-MHC, GPCR and glycosylated receptor systems within one comparative framing.

ranked.headline: Computational methods resolve proteoform, molecular variant, and fold-switching protein…
ranked.summary: Scaled computational pipelines now integrate mass spectra, sequence, and structure prediction to characterize molecular identity.

ranked.headline: Biophysical models link external fields and sensory context to neural responses
ranked.summary: Realistic-geometry and mechanistic models now quantify how fields, ephaptic coupling, and sensory context shape neural responses.

ranked.headline: Learned dynamical and embedding models predict microbial behavior from sparse data
ranked.summary: Four December 2025 preprints apply deep and semi-supervised models to microbial, viral, and pathogen-surveillance data with limited labels.

ranked.headline: Genome-wide maps link replication origins, duplication-driven rewiring, and miRNA pairs
ranked.summary: Large WGS and T2T-based analyses now resolve replication origins and duplication-derived regulatory elements at genome scale.

ranked.headline: Structure-conditioned generative design of RNA and single-stranded DNA sequences
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and an open-source tool extend generative nucleic acid design to explicit three-dimensional and motif-level structural targets.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools for phylogenetic, pangenome, and circadian data analysis and…
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication describe open-source tools for phylogenetic, pangenome graph, and circadian rhythm analysis.

ranked.headline: Curation pipelines and tools for harmonizing omics metadata and variant interpretation
ranked.summary: Manual curation and harmonization of large metadata and variant resources are being formalized into reusable software and data infrastructure.

ranked.headline: New platforms extend 13C isotope-labeling metabolic flux analysis
ranked.summary: Isotope-labeling flux tools now span untargeted, targeted, stationary, and nonstationary 13C workflows.
